_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). Handheld Stories' Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids HA–HC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

HA.name: Walkthrough: the film in a browser frame with the four pages as chapters, the museum visit as a photo strip, a drag-to-turn Coiled Snake, the 150 roto frames

HB.name: Collection record: the turning ring and film as the object, a museum label, a slider through six drafts, two catalogue rows sliding with the scroll

HC.name: UI kit: four screens as a 2x2, the type scale as a ladder, live hover and info-box components, linear vs eased cursor, the film

HA2.name: Walkthrough, refined: the browser frame opens on Catalogue, museum strip, drag-to-turn snake, 150 roto frames on black, a live two-layer hover and the seven exports

HD.name: Still / Moving: drag between each page's Photoshop still and its animated cut, the visit as a dealt deck, drafts on a light table, the roto as onion skin

HE.name: Audio guide: a handset keypad steps through six stops of the making, the catalogue rows sliding with the scroll, the database list driving the film
